note: NECO English round 4 (Round 26 top-up): fresh synonyms (diligent, cordial, obsolete, candid), antonyms (scarce, humble, transparent), idioms (burn the midnight oil, blessing in disguise, hit the nail on the head, once in a blue moon), collocations (heavy rain, make a living), context meanings (erratic, impartial), tense (future perfect, since-present perfect, past perfect), concord (neither was, each has), prepositions (afraid of, congratulate on, insist on), conjunctions (although, both-and), determiners (either of two, theirs), orals: seat-meat, cat-bat, boy-noise, silent b in comb, ph as f, cough-off, height-bite, photographer second-syllable stress, understand third-syllable stress, bear/flour homophones, rising intonation on yes-no questions. Scanned against NECO English r1 (batch 052), WAEC English (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
